name: Synthetic data generator + SQLite (churn_data.db)
captured: Seeded, fully synthetic accounts, 12 monthly telemetry/support/commercial snapshots, interventions, churn events and spend history written by generate_synthetic_data.py. No customer data is used.
supports: Every value currently shown in this dashboard.

name: CRM account master
captured: Account ID, hierarchy, product ownership, region, segment, lifecycle stage, owner and active/inactive status.
supports: Total accounts, product/region/segment cuts, owner coverage and account-level records.

name: Contract & billing system
captured: Contract start/end date, renewal date, recurring revenue, expansion, contraction, cancellation and currency.
supports: Renewal pipeline, churn rate, NRR, days to renewal, renewal amount and RFM Monetary value.

name: Product telemetry warehouse
captured: Eligible seats, activation, active users, feature events, workflow depth, frequency, recency and integration usage.
supports: Health score, adoption decline, product-adoption and integration drivers, RFM Recency and Frequency.

name: Customer Success platform
captured: Success plans, customer touchpoints, sponsor/champion status, business outcomes, playbook enrollment and completed interventions.
supports: Engagement signals, recommended actions, playbook eligibility, post-intervention improvement and governed Recency fallback.

name: Support case management
captured: Open and closed cases, severity, age, SLA status, escalations, resolution time and customer-impact classification.
supports: Support Experience driver, critical-ticket alerts and recommended actions.

name: Voice of Customer / survey platform
captured: NPS/CSAT responses, qualitative themes, perceived value, pricing concerns and onboarding feedback.
supports: Perceived Value / ROI, Pricing / Cost, Onboarding and competing-solution drivers.

name: Identity & access service
captured: Provisioned users, licensed seats, admin roles, sign-ins and activation status.
supports: Multi-user activation, owner/admin coverage and eligible-account denominators.

name: Enablement / learning system
captured: Onboarding milestones, course enrollment, attendance, completion and learning pathways.
supports: Onboarding completion and training participation drivers.

name: Alert & workflow store
captured: Threshold breaches, score movements, alert state, owner acknowledgement and workflow execution.
supports: Alert count, recommended-action counts and intervention tracking.

name: Third-party firmographic enrichment
captured: Industry, company size, growth signals, ownership changes and other licensed firmographic attributes.
supports: Optional model features and benchmarking; not required for core financial or usage metrics.
